extensionDescription.message: Export Firefox tabs to Markdown, JSON, HTML, or plain text
extensionDescription.description: Description shown in the add-ons manager

popupTitle.description: Title shown in the popup header

tipSettings.message: Open persistent settings (default format, filters, etc.)

tipTabSummary.message: Number of tabs that will be included in the export (updates with your filter settings)

tipFormatMarkdown.message: Markdown — great for note-taking apps like Obsidian, Notion, or any text editor. Exports as clickable [Title](URL) links.

tipFormatJson.message: JSON — structured data format. Includes full tab metadata (window, container, favicon, pinned state). Great for developers or importing into other tools.

tipFormatHtml.message: HTML — self-contained webpage with clickable links, favicons, and section headings per group/container. Open directly in any browser.

tipFormatText.message: Plain Text — simple list of tab titles and URLs. Works everywhere: email, Notepad, terminal, or any plain text tool.

tipScope.message: Choose which tabs to export: all open tabs, a specific tab group (colour-coded groups in your tab bar), a Firefox Container, or only the ungrouped tabs.

tipRefresh.message: Refresh — re-scans your open tabs for new groups or containers

tipOptTitle.message: ON: exports both the page title and URL (e.g. 'Google – https://google.com'). OFF: exports URLs only — useful for privacy or cleaner lists.

tipOptFilter.message: ON: skips browser internal pages like 'New Tab', 'about:settings', and extension pages. OFF: includes everything. The tab count above updates live.

tipDownload.message: Save tabs as a file in the chosen format. File is named automatically with today's date and time.

tipCopy.message: Copy the export text directly to your clipboard — no file saved. Paste anywhere you like.

optionsSubtitle.message: Preferences persist across all sessions and browser restarts.

descIncludeTitle.message: Include the tab title in exported output

descFilterInternal.message: Exclude about:, moz-extension:, and other internal URLs
